title: Freya and the Winter
author: Zephyrine Galloway
blurb: Lena Brightwater, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
